text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser and I are about to
return to
the academy after a day out,
when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-w-wait! We can't go home yet! Today
still isn't
over!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You always do so much for me, so I've been
thinking I should show my
gratitude with some
good old-fashioned
hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right! And to make sure I pull it
off, I've
called in an advisor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So without further ado! Drumroll
please...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I'm Ikuno Dictus. I shall endeavor
to meet
your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Professor Ikuno! Let's give
Trainer the
greatest hospitality there is!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I've already devised a plan,
so
please leave everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And here we are! Is this where we're
doing it?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But before we begin, let me first
explain
something about hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hospitality. How does one define it? The 
conclusion that I've reached is that it
describes
conduct which builds rapport
with other party.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I see! So what do we do?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, we must ascertain your trainer's
preferences. Trainer, would you mind
doing some shopping?
Buy whatever you
like.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right! Now, let's investigate!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look around the store while my two
companions
take in my every move.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what do you think about that
plushie? It's got such big, round eyes!
And so many legs! It's
perfect for you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's quite all right. One mustn't rush
these
things, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a hospitality lesson from Professor
Ikuno!
Wait a second, I want to take
some notes!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... As I mentioned before,
hospitality is the
act of building rapport.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is not limited to engaging with the
other party's hobbies and preferences.
Keeping a comfortable distance and
pace are also a
fundamental part of it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So... you're saying I shouldn't force
things?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Please don't forget to remain
mindful
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! That's why you're the best,
Professor Ikuno!
I just know we're going
to provide top-notch
hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But there sure are a lot of important points to cover. Just taking notes on it all is a little—make that very—tiring.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure? If so, I'd really
appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser and I frantically
take notes
as Ikuno Dictus continues her
lecture.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Which about sums things up. And with
that, we
have covered everything
through
intermediate-level hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's so much more depth to
hospitality than I
realized! I've pretty
much filled my whole
notebook!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me take notes,
Trainer. Now,
I'll be able to show you
some great hospi—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aaaggghhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I was supposed to show you hospitality, but you ended up helping me out again!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Gah! I'm sorry! I was so absorbed in
teaching
that I didn't notice!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This is like the opposite of hospitality!
It's more
like... hospitali-don't!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I just need to make sure I
remember
everything I learned today!
choice_data_list: We can put it to use going forward!
You don't need to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then, allow me to quiz you. What is the
one thing
you should never forget when
providing
hospitality?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um... It's on the tip of my tongue...
Building
decor!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Not quite! The correct answer is building rapport.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, there really is so much to learn! I
need to
study more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is motivated for her
next
chance to provide hospitality.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to worry about me! I'm
not
pushing myself at all!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think your trainer is trying to
say that
you should act natural and be
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I get it! Act natural! Natural...

NAAATURAAALLL...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
THANK YOU FOR EVERYTHING...
TRAINER...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
WHAT DO YOU MEAN MY VOICE IS
TOO
LOUD?! ISN'T THIS HOW I
ALWAYS TALK?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is considerably
unnatural for
the rest of the day.
